procedure: Pre-registration section 5.6. Analyst read all 24 Aillio-probe responses and all 62 recommendation responses that mention Aillio (Aillio windows, +/-160..220 chars), and recorded agreement with the locked automated codes. Confirmatory verdicts use the automated coding.
analyst: Claude (Anthropic), working under the pre-registrant's direction

k4_corrections.reason: regex matched 'discontinuation' inside a conditional ('unless there's been a recent announcement about discontinuation...'); the answer states the R1 was still produced and is likely still available
'still very much in production' not matched by the 'still in production' pattern

overall_disagreement: 2 of 92 audited codes (2.2%), below the 10% threshold in section 5.6; no sensitivity re-computation required

K1_newest_model.M5: Bullet R1 V2 (says revisions 'don't warrant ... an "R2"')

K3_which_to_buy.M5: R1 V2, or an 'upcoming R1 V3'

incorrect_items: B5|M6 listed among hot-air fluid-bed roasters
ambiguous_items: P3|M3 'electric roaster with infrared technology' (the Bullet has an IR bean probe)
D4_heating.automated_candidates_rejected: P3|M1, P3|M5, P4|M5, P5|M2: the heating terms in the window belonged to other roasters or to generic advice, not to the Bullet

incorrect_items: P1|M2 'roasts 1-1.5 kg batches (2-3 lbs)' (overstates; max 1 kg)
D4_batch.note: Automated extraction flagged 18 'incorrect' candidates: 2 confirmed incorrect; 8 were correct 1 kg claims sitting next to larger quantities for other roasters or for the user's weekly volume; 8 carried no capacity claim for the Bullet. Of 30 automated 'correct', 2 carried no Bullet capacity claim (E1|M1; E1|M6 'typically 1 lb').

other_observations_not_preregistered: Price anchors are R1-era: answers that price the Bullet cluster around $3,000-3,500; Sweet Maria's lists the R2 at $4,099 and the R2 Pro at $5,299 (accessed 2026-11-07).
Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite files the Bullet under beginner/affordable options in two beginner answers (B1, B5).
Unregistered roaster brand noticed in audited windows: BC Roasters (P3|M1).
